violations.rule: Net Quantity — Missing Space Between Numeral and Unit
violations.message: Net quantity "TOTAL NET WT. & QTY 300g + 1N TOOTHBRUSH" does not separate the numeral and unit with a space (e.g. "100g" should be "100 g") as required by SI convention under LM(PC) Rules.
violations.remedial_action: Insert a space between the numeric value and the unit symbol (e.g. "200 g", "500 ml").

violations.message: Dimensions or sizes are not declared. Rule 6(1)(f) of LM(PC) Rules requires dimensional details on packages of items sold by size (sheets, wipes, bags, containers, fabrics).
violations.remedial_action: Declare the dimensions or size of the commodity on the label (e.g. "30 cm × 20 cm", "A4").

violations.message: LMPC Registration details are absent. Rule 27 requires manufacturers, packers, or importers to register their premises with the Director/Controller of Legal Metrology.
violations.remedial_action: Ensure the package or listing bears the valid Legal Metrology Registration Number.
